term: selected governing-power criterion and its matching institutional bridge
definition: A selected predicate on the existing Power carrier is compared with the fixed narrow table or that table plus teaching. InstitutionLinkFor preserves the original mandate, Catholic-body, visibility and teaching conditions while quantifying over the selected governing predicate. A classification alone is not a historical grant or an institutional-foundation rule.
note: Analyst sibling configurations with attribution deferred. The nine constructors do not exhaust every real ecclesial power or jurisdiction; all coverage here is relative to that fixed carrier. Teaching can convey content or exercise binding institutional authority; the criterion and matching bridge decide what consequence is being assumed. Gave retains the old gave-or-promised/recipient interpretation and is not newly identified by type with the root jesus. Named coverage is open; Other can admit or reject the old mandate target. No institutional source claim or fulfilled promise is established.
